encoder: Ridge regression from modality B to modality A using 96 training keys; all paired examples convey only correspondence, never a canonical address.
key_split: Of 256 compositional keys, 96 train, 64 selection, 96 confirmation; pools disjoint within each independently transformed fit.
domains_scope: IID is already unseen-key generalization; long_gap multiplies public dt by 10; noise_interference raises query-view noise from .03 to .12 and typed distractors per query from 2 to 8. This is synthetic compositional binding, not language, audio, images, or unknown-distractor recognition.
gated_delta_scope: A selected gated linear associative recurrence with online delta updates, not a BPTT-trained GRU or modern selective SSM. No HX arm or analytic-core gain is tested here.
selection: Choose one encoder by independent paired-view selection MSE; then choose each memory family by mean actual selection accuracy, fixed listed-order ties. All encoder/memory candidates and costs retained. Select the strongest ordinary family on the same selection episodes and freeze before confirmation.
oracle: Privileged exact-key identities plus public WRITE values; no future targets. It is an upper bound, not a same-information competitor.
contents: Eight slots and eight values, 24 queries, scheduled repeated queries, five changed overwrites, typed distractors, no hidden content drift.

fees.scope: Mandatory public operations shared by all arms. Utility is mean correctness minus total fees/24. There is no optional value controller in this content-only experiment.

primary_acceptance: All three domains must have the frozen selected ordinary family's one-sided simultaneous lower bound on accuracy strictly above .90. Bonferroni three-domain family alpha .05, Student t across eight independent fits, df=7. No claim that the gate proves analytic-core value.
inference: Fit is the independent unit; episodes and 24 queries are averaged within fit. All candidate comparisons descriptive. No significance rescue via a selected confirmation arm or a relaxed domain gate.
costs: All fitting and candidate selection, public data generation, each arm's binding and memory work, raw output serialization, and process CPU are recorded where measured. Task fees are not CPU costs. Report explicit array bytes; no object/RSS, energy, network or production claim.
freezes: Publish source/protocol before registered training; publish all fitted weights and family/parameter selections before confirmation. Confirmation requires both publication SHAs and exact source hashes. Development seed never enters formal statistics.
